# Squorum — Pickleball Court Directory

> Squorum is a pickleball court directory and SMS-based game coordination agent for the upper Midwest.

## Pages

- [All Courts](/courts): Browse pickleball courts by state
- [Minnesota Courts](/courts/minnesota): Pickleball courts across Minnesota
- [Iowa Courts](/courts/iowa): Pickleball courts across Iowa

## Data

Each court listing includes:
- Name, address, city, state, zip code
- Court count (indoor and outdoor breakdown)
- Surface type (concrete, asphalt, sport court, wood, composite)
- Access type (public, private, semi-private)
- Cost (free, per hour, membership, drop-in)
- Amenities (restrooms, water, parking, lighting, and more)
- Reservation requirements and booking links
- GPS coordinates

## Coverage

- Minnesota: 444 courts across 100+ cities
- Iowa: 290 courts across 100+ cities
- Data sourced from Pickleheads, municipal parks departments, and manual verification

## API

Court data is available via Supabase public API with row-level security.
Table: `pickleball_locations` — SELECT access enabled for all.

## Contact

- SMS: Text any message to the Squorum number to coordinate pickleball games
- Web: https://squorum.com
